topics.purpose: 4th-perspective design check for a non-circular B*_Q6 <-> E3(lambda=-3) spectral-alignment test.
topics.question: The bio pipeline just exported its B*_Q6 residual basis: 9 within-synonymous (amino-acid-residual) zero-sum codon contrasts, defined PURELY from codon spelling + the genetic code's synonymous degeneracy (K_AAA: AAA=+1,AAG=-1; Arg_AGR: AGA=AGG=+1,CGN=-0.25; Ile_AUA: AUA=+1,AUU=AUC=-1; Leu CUN-vs-UUR; Leu UUA-vs-UUG; Ser UCR-vs-AGY; Ser UCA-vs-UCG; Thr ACR-vs-ACY; f3_stress=sum over 21 families of first-minus-last codon). NO q6/Foldbin/Zeckendorf labels are used (verified in bio source). Their support union is exactly the 13 codons that the bridge's edge-hiding experiment independently reproduces. Bio's CROSS-ORGANISM data is non-resolving (dominant-coordinate permutation p=0.58; measured tRNA-tAI and TE absorb <=2% of the residual). On the math side the bridge has CERTIFIED that the codon Hamming graph H(3,4) has integer Krawtchouk eigenspaces E0,E1,E2,E3 (dims 1,9,27,27; eigenvalues 9,5,1,-3) and that H3 = E3 = the canonical lambda=-3 eigenspace. PROPOSED bridge test: does the bio-intrinsic B*_Q6 basis CONCENTRATE in E3 (rho_3 = ||P_E3 q||^2/||q||^2) significantly MORE than a matched null of random within-synonymous zero-sum contrasts? CRITICAL worry: synonymous-mean-removed contrasts may GENERICALLY avoid E0/E1 and live in E2+E3 for ALL synonymous contrasts, making high rho_3 trivial. QUESTIONS, brutally honest + anti-numerology: (1) Is this test non-circular and non-trivial, or does the matched null swamp it? (2) What is the SHARPEST invariant statistic (per-vector rho_3 / mean rho_3 / principal-angles between span(B*_Q6) and E3 / projector-trace)? (3) Is selecting exactly the >2-fold degenerate families quietly q6-motivated (a hidden circularity)? (4) What single outcome would justify 'certified structural forcing' vs merely 'coincidence', given anti-numerology? If the test is vacuous, say so and name the non-vacuous alternative.
